previous_goals.title: Build and validate the current JTAG design
previous_goals.text: I compiled the current JTAG loader design with Quartus Prime Lite 25.1 on October 29, three days after my build target. I fixed IP generation, removed stale GPIO assignments and added JTAG I/O timing constraints. All timing checks pass at 50 MHz, with zero unconstrained paths and worst setup/hold margins of +2.339/+0.096 ns. I archived the reports and SOF hash.

previous_goals.title: Test the CPU on the DE10-Lite
previous_goals.text: I tested the CPU on the DE10-Lite on October 29, ahead of the October 30 target. The console shows loader startup, a CRC-verified hello upload and two runs returning EXIT 0000002A and ready>. I saved a board photo and console screenshot. The remaining work is a recorded reset-after-upload and interrupted-upload recovery sequence, which I carried into next week's first goal.

previous_goals.title: Verify a second uploaded assembly application
previous_goals.text: I converted the mixed RAM loop into an uploadable assembly application and tested it in simulation and on the board on October 29, before the November 6 target. It checks the five stored sums 1, 3, 6, 10 and 15. The console records a 428-byte upload and two successful runs returning EXIT 0000000F. I added the procedure and board evidence to the upload guide.

next_goals.title: Complete hardware recovery and repeatability checks
next_goals.text: By November 6, I will finish the board recovery checks carried forward from this week's hardware goal. I will test KEY(0) after an application run, confirm that execution requires a fresh upload, and recover from an interrupted transfer and a bad CRC. I will record the commands, expected and observed results, cable selection and SOF hash in a console log and acceptance checklist.

next_goals.title: Update and verify the illustrated user guide
next_goals.text: By November 6, I will update the illustrated user guide with the tested Quartus build, JTAG timing checks, Python setup and both application examples. I will include this week's board photo and console results, then add the recovery evidence from Goal 1. I will follow the revised instructions from a fresh terminal and correct any missing steps before saving the final guide.

next_goals.title: Draft the final report and demonstration plan
next_goals.text: By November 12, I will draft the final report and a demonstration plan using the architecture, simulation, timing and board evidence. I will organize the results and remaining limitations, then outline a demonstration of programming, upload, execution, rerun and reset recovery. I will use the draft for a November 19 review checkpoint and keep the existing November 24 through December 4 final report and demonstration window.
